components.name: Button
components.description:
Button — Figma: "Button" (BASED COMPONENTS → Button).
Figma "Label" is the children. Figma "State" is handled by the browser: hover, pressed (active),
focus (keyboard, 2px focus ring) and `disabled`.

variant.description: Figma "Variant". Filled for the single primary action; Tonal, Outline, Ghost for less emphasis.

tone.description: Figma "Tone". Danger only for destructive actions.

leftIcon.description: Figma "Show left icon" + "Left icon". Pass an `<Icon />`; its size and color are set for you.

rightIcon.description: Figma "Show right icon" + "Right icon". Pass an `<Icon />`; its size and color are set for you.

components.name: Icon
components.description:
Icon — Figma: "Icon" page, Coolicon set.
Takes the color of the surrounding text (`currentColor`), so set color with `text-content-*` / `text-icon-*`
on the icon or its parent.

name.description: Icon name: the Figma icon name in kebab case (Figma "Edit / Add_Plus" → `add-plus`).

size.description: Size token: `icon-xs` 12 · `icon-sm` 16 · `icon-md` 20 · `icon-lg` 24. Inside Button and Icon Button the size is set for you.

label.description: Accessible name. Leave empty for decorative icons (next to text); they are hidden from screen readers.
